data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to check auto time and auto timezone settings and open device settings.
data.what_it_does: It provides functionality to check whether the device's auto time and auto timezone settings are enabled. It also allows developers to open the device settings if they are not set to auto.
use_when: You need to verify if the device uses automatic date and time settings.
You want to prompt users to enable auto time or auto timezone on their device.
avoid_when: You do not need to interact with system-level date and time configurations.
You are targeting platforms other than Android where this plugin's features might not apply.
strengths: Simple API for checking auto time and auto timezone status.
Includes functionality to open system settings directly.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and platform details beyond Android plugin classification.
